issuance.ISSUANCEDATE: chart-issuance, chart-term, chart-yields, chart-cover, kpi:issuance_ytd, kpi:last_auction, insight:issuance_ytd
issuance.SERIES: skip: TASE security number of each series — an identifier; the bond type and term carry the meaning
issuance.ACTUALTERMTOMATURITY: skip: remaining term at a re-opening; the page groups by ORIGINALTERMTOMATURITY, the series' designed term
issuance.REDEMTIONDATE: skip: maturity of the issued series — maturities are shown from the redemptions table, which covers all debt rather than one year's auctions
issuance.COUPON: skip: coupons differ by bond type and vintage; the auction yield (GROSSAVGYIELD) is the comparable price of borrowing
issuance.PURCHASEDQUANTITY: chart-yields — weights the monthly average yield
issuance.ADDITIONALPURCHASED: skip: post-auction add-on purchases by market makers; small and already inside TOTALFUNDING
issuance.AVERAGEPRICE: skip: price per 100 nominal — the yield expresses the same information comparably across coupons
issuance.CUTOFFPRICE: skip: marginal price; the page uses the average yield
issuance.TOTALFUNDING: chart-issuance, chart-term, kpi:issuance_ytd, insight:issuance_ytd, insight:linked, insight:term
issuance.COVERRATIO: skip: per-auction ratio; the page recomputes it from demand and offered amounts so monthly and yearly figures are properly weighted
issuance.GROSSCUTOFFYIELD: skip: marginal (cut-off) yield, within a few basis points of the average yield charted
nontradable.BONDS: skip: one bond family (ערד) throughout — constant
nontradable.ACTUALTERMTOMATURITY: skip: constant 15-year term for every issue
nontradable.REDEMPTIONDATE: skip: issue date plus the constant 15-year term
nontradable.COUPON: skip: a single fixed coupon across issues
redemptions.DATATYPE: chart-redemptions, insight:wall — actual indication vs forecast
linkage.TRADABLEORNONTRADABLE: skip: the same tradable split is charted from the redemptions table
linkage.DATATYPE: skip: actual vs forecast is marked on the redemptions chart from the same source
switch.PURCHASEDBONDNAME: skip: per-auction series names (hundreds); the page aggregates volumes by year
switch.PURCHASEDORIGINALYEARSTOREDEMPTIO: skip: original term of the bond bought back — the page shows switch volumes, not a term breakdown
switch.PURCHASEDREDEMPTIONDATE: skip: maturity of the bond bought back
switch.ISSUEDORIGINALYEARSTOREDEMPTION: skip: original term of the bond issued in exchange
switch.ISSUEDACTUALYEARSTOREDEMPTION: skip: remaining term of the bond issued in exchange
switch.ISSUEDREDEMPTIONDATE: skip: maturity of the bond issued in exchange
switch.CONVERSIONRATIOAVERAGE: skip: price ratio between the two series of each auction — not meaningful when aggregated across series
buyback.BONDS: skip: bond type of each repurchase; volumes are small and shown by year
buyback.ACTUALTERMTOMATURITY: skip: remaining term of the repurchased bond (mostly under a year)
buyback.ORIGINALTERMTOMATURITY: skip: original term of the repurchased bond
buyback.REDEMPTIONDATE: skip: maturity of the repurchased bond
buyback.COUPON: skip: coupon of the repurchased bond
buyback.TOTALFINANCIAL: skip: cash paid — tracks PURCHASEDQUANTITY closely (prices near par)
buyback.DEMANDEDAMOUNT: skip: offers received in reverse auctions — the table stops in 2023
buyback.ALLOCATIONPERCENTINCUTOFFPRICE: skip: allotment at the cut-off price — auction mechanics
trading.LENDINGBALANCE: skip: securities-lending balance per bond and day — a stock, not a flow; unit and lending terms are not documented
trading._resource_name: skip: the two trading files are consecutive periods (2004–2019, 2020 on); no per-file view is needed
